##### Project general facts

Upper House by Ellington Properties is a premium residential development, offering a collection of thoughtfully designed studios and 1–3 bedroom apartments. The project consists of two distinctive towers, each rising above podium levels and designed with a modern architectural approach that maximizes space, light, and panoramic views of Jumeirah Islands and the Marina skyline. With its contemporary design and functional layouts, the development creates a refined urban living environment centered around comfort and convenience.

Residents benefit from an extensive range of amenities designed to support an active and balanced lifestyle. The development features a large swimming pool and children’s pool, fitness center, gym, yoga studio, spa areas, and sports facilities including tennis and mini golf. In addition, residents can enjoy a gourmet restaurant, landscaped leisure spaces, children’s play areas, and dedicated conference rooms, creating a vibrant community atmosphere for both relaxation and social interaction.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, complemented by a clean design and neutral color palette that enhances the sense of space. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide abundant natural light, while smart home systems allow control of lighting, air conditioning, and access. The kitchens are fully equipped with appliances, including a gas stove, oven, fridge, freezer, microwave, and dishwasher. The apartments are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Lakes Towers is a vibrant mixed-use community in the heart of Dubai, known for its cluster-based layout of residential and commercial towers set around a series of scenic artificial lakes. The district offers a balanced urban lifestyle, combining high-rise living with waterfront promenades, landscaped parks, and a relaxed, walkable atmosphere. Its dynamic character makes it popular among professionals, families, and investors alike.

The area is well-equipped with everyday conveniences, including a wide selection of restaurants, cafés, retail outlets, supermarkets, fitness centers, and wellness facilities. Community parks, jogging tracks, and pet-friendly spaces create an active outdoor environment, while the lively social scene and regular events add to its appeal. Residents enjoy a self-sufficient lifestyle with everything needed within close reach.

Jumeirah Lakes Towers benefits from excellent connectivity, with direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road and close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, and key business hubs. The community is served by two metro stations, making commuting easy and efficient. Its central location, combined with waterfront views and a strong sense of community, makes JLT one of Dubai’s most sought-after residential destinations.
